name: Accelerating Sphere Tracing
definition: A sphere tracing acceleration method that predicts the next step distance by assuming the object surface is planar near the current ray position, allowing for larger, more aggressive steps than standard over-relaxation while reducing the frequency of overshoot corrections.
summary: Accelerating Sphere Tracing is a ray marching method that predicts step distances using a planar surface assumption and historical SDF values to enable larger steps than standard techniques.
